node.title: Alcance de bloqueo de una decisión
node.summary: Trace dependent results delayed or blocked by a decision.

relations: Decision-level dispersion and downstream coupling make the coordination-entropy discussion more precise by separating agreement burden from the propagation of a blocked decision.
Son unidades distintas: número de personas, puertas de acuerdo y dependencias de proceso no se sustituyen entre sí.
Reach-weighted latency can operationalize one aspect of informational friction, but the causal loss from a divergent map must still be separated from necessary waiting and other delays.
No se identifica algebraicamente F con la magnitud teórica ni se interpreta todo retraso como ineficiencia.
